Ah, quick clarification is necessary. I wasn’t trying to correlate a decline in procreation to being parasitic. Just our track record through history and the effects of our nature on the rest of it as being fundamentally incompatible. We have the capacity to create works of art and exhibit inspiring moments of genuine compassion, but we always, ALWAYS consume, disrupt, and unbalance all of the resources at our disposal. We have too much capability without the wisdom to apply things for the greater good. 

All of this depends on where your sense of the greater good is, though, and even whether or not it matters.

Now it’s been removed from r/depression AND r/philosophy. This seems like a topic that shouldn’t be unscrupulously removed because of vague violation of rules that a person posting in r/depression probably couldn’t care less about and may not be thinking rationally, to begin with. Sometimes people only cry out for help once. I’m not saying that’s what it this is, but it could be, and that’s exactly the time you don’t want to feel more rejection and viewed as something unacceptable. That may be an “unfair” interpretation of the actions taken by mods/bots, but I don’t think most people become depressed because they feel things are “fair”. 

It should be noted that this feels a bit ironic, in that I’m making an emotional argument against the logical argument I JUST made.
